entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Island in the Terisian Isles of Dominaria, formerly a coastal kingdom of Terisiare and later a Southern City-State.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: Great war of Terisiare during which Korlis was a coastal kingdom.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Lord High Protector of the Combined Kingdoms, whose armies harvested Korlis's forests.

entities.name: Combined Kingdoms
entities.description: Union that Korlis joined in 36 AR.

entities.name: Martyrs of Korlis
entities.description: Young idealists inspired by Korlis who were killed in the war.

entities.name: Liberation of Yotia
entities.description: Event instigated by the deaths of the Martyrs of Korlis.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church that liberated Korlis from a machine warlord after the war.

entities.name: Southern City-States
entities.description: Twelve city-states of the Dark Age, of which Korlis became one.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: United nation of which the island of Korlis is now part.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Flood that put most of Fyndhorn beneath the waves, leaving Korlis an island.

entities.name: Peace Summit at Korlinda
entities.description: Aborted peace conference between Argive, Korlis, Yotia and the Fallaji two years before the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Peace Summit at Korlinda, an aborted conference, is held two years before the Brothers' War.
events.quote: an aborted peace conference between Argive , Korlis, Yotia , and the Fallaji , two years before the beginning of the Brother's War

events.summary: In 36 AR Korlis becomes part of the Combined Kingdoms under Urza.
events.quote: In 36 AR , Korlis became part of the Combined Kingdoms , which had Urza as its Lord High Protector.

events.summary: The Church of Tal liberates Korlis from a machine warlord after the war.
events.quote: After the war, the Church of Tal liberated Korlis from a machine warlord.

events.summary: Korlis declines to a city-state among the Southern City-States.
events.quote: the former nation had become one of the Southern City-States

events.summary: The Flooding of Terisiare leaves a portion of the land as the island of Korlis in the Shattered Sea.
events.quote: a portion of the green land survived in the form of an island in the newly created Shattered Sea

relations.quote: Korlis is an island in the archipelago of the Terisian Isles of Dominaria .
In 36 AR , Korlis became part of the Combined Kingdoms
It is considered part of the united nation of New Argive .
the Combined Kingdoms , which had Urza as its Lord High Protector
